sources.title: Open Resources for Community College Algebra
allowed_scope: public checkpoint solutions and answer material covered by the book license
excluded_scope: PCC and ORCCA names used as product branding
external media without a compatible file-level license
sources.quality_basis: Written by Portland Community College mathematics faculty, class-tested, and approved by the AIM Open Textbook Initiative
sources.attribution_template: Original source material, products with readable and accessible math content, and other information are freely available at pcc.edu/orcca.
sources.version_rule: Register each imported edition and part separately and compute a content checksum before parsing.

sources.title: Active Prelude to Calculus
allowed_scope: exercises and answers included in the licensed text
excluded_scope: externally hosted WeBWorK or Doenet content without separate license verification
sources.quality_basis: Open active-learning precalculus text maintained by experienced mathematics faculty
sources.version_rule: Pin the HTML snapshot date and checksum because the online edition receives corrections.

sources.title: Active Calculus Single Variable, Second Edition
allowed_scope: selected exercises and answers included in the licensed text
excluded_scope: external WeBWorK or Doenet components without separate license verification
sources.version_rule: Use the explicit second edition and record the published snapshot checksum.

sources.title: Advanced High School Statistics
sources.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 for the textbook, subject to file-level exceptions
allowed_scope: textbook source files covered by the repository license
public exercises and in-book answers covered by the same license
excluded_scope: OpenIntro trademarks, logos and cover art
third-party photographs or datasets without compatible reuse terms
partner resources not owned by OpenIntro
sources.quality_basis: High-school statistics text with public source files, classroom adoption and maintained errata
sources.version_rule: Pin a repository commit and retain its LICENSE file; audit every image and dataset before ingestion.

sources.title: Discrete Mathematics: An Open Introduction, Third Edition
allowed_scope: combinatorics, sequences and introductory number theory
public exercises, hints and selected solutions
excluded_scope: Open Problem Library exercises without separate provenance verification
sources.quality_basis: AIM-approved textbook adopted by many institutions, with exercises, hints and solutions
sources.version_rule: Pin the third-edition tag or commit; never follow an unversioned URL into the noncommercial fourth edition.

blocked_sources.reason: Current OpenStax terms use a noncommercial license and explicitly require prior written permission for ingestion into large language models or generative AI offerings.
The project already marks this dataset as evaluation-only; adding it to RAG would invalidate the held-out evaluation and violate the upstream training restriction.
Authenticated instructor resources are not public ingestion sources even when the related textbook is openly licensed.
Public accessibility alone does not establish reuse rights, quality review, or reproducible provenance.
